{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker columns
sentinel_values = [-999.0, -999, -999.00, -999.000]

# Check baseline and final biomarker columns for sentinel values
baseline_sentinels = df['biomarker_baseline'].isin(sentinel_values).sum()
final_sentinels = df['biomarker_final'].isin(sentinel_values).sum()

baseline_sentinels, final_sentinels"}
